'''Joe Streleckis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 12th at [[June 2001 Jenkintown tournament]] on 24 June 2001, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2510">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-jenkintown-pa-6-24-01d2510/ jenkintown-pa-6-24-01], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-jenkintown-pa-6-24-01d2510/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
